title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Verification of… (CVE-2026-91908)
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 have an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability. This flaw allows a high privileged attacker with adjacent network access to potentially execute code on the affected system. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.7. No specific affected versions were explicitly stated beyond 'prior to 4.8.0'. There is no information about available patches or vendor advisories in the provided data.
